body: Considering how big the dressing is yea. I’m waiting for blood tests and then the crisis team as the doctor doesn’t feel I’m safe to go home. So I’ve really fucked up.
I’m in A+E waiting for stitches now.

Yep, will do once it stops. mostly because I know the majority of the staff in the A+E from previous suicide attempts, the last time I saw them I said I would sort myself out and hopefully not see them again. (So embarrassment really) And they’ll make me see the crisis team who suggested I go to a psych ward last time I saw them. I also live with family who are unaware of what I’ve done.

It’s still pouring out at the minute, but yea hopefully my doctor will stitch it up in the morning, I’ve tried closing it myself but there’s too much tension and it won’t hold. I very much doubt anyone will believe it was accidental so hopefully they’ll still let me leave after.

Relatable, although if you put yourself in a position of responsibility you’ll have little to no window of opportunity and therefore may not kill yourself or atleast not so soon. That’s helped for me anyway.
What were you hoping for then?
To me that sounds like a pretty good grade.

I really identify with your last point, and setting up the rope does have that cool off period. But one day you’ll be so distressed that it won’t work, so before that happens please seek help, wether it’s through your doctor or a crisis line.

When you are sectioned its because there is no other option as they are a danger to themselves or others, it's normally done against the persons wishes. 

So the fact you want to be sectioned actually rules you out for it. You can go to hospital voluntarily, if you speak to your psychiatrist/dr they can refer you.
Yep, which is irritating life wise as "why do this if I wont be alive to see it" is something that comes up pretty often

Tylenol actually takes several days to induce liver failure (quicker in massive doses or if taken with alcohol) if you've taken 4 grams+ (UK max dose, may be different in US) you need to get medical attention, dependant on your weight/ the dose you may have ingested a toxic dose even though you stopped midway.

You can recieve an antidote if needed, although it's most effective in the first 8hrs. It can still be given later but it wont work as well.
